look_here_first: Inspect low sprawling thin stems and opposite leaves; focus on the petal splits, 5 sepals, stamens and the mature capsule teeth to distinguish closely related starworts.

verified_photos.creator: Carlos G Velazco-Macias
verified_photos.role: Visually reviewed existing habitat/flowering view: low slender branching stems bearing small white star-shaped flowers with deeply divided petals; scattered small leaves visible among mixed ground vegetation. Flower centers, sepal count, capsule teeth and individual leaf attachment are not resolved at this scale; do not treat surrounding foliage as confirmed Stellaria.
